analyst.summary: Swiggy's food-delivery business has become a real, if modest, profit generator, but the company overall keeps losing MORE money each year (Rs 4,154cr FY26 loss, up from Rs 3,117cr) because its Instamart quick-commerce arm is still burning cash chasing growth against a bigger, already-profitable rival (Blinkit) and a new low-cost entrant in food delivery (Rapido's Ownly). Management itself just pushed back its own timeline for quick-commerce to reach full profitability by an extra year. Until that burn visibly narrows, we rate this a Sell.
